run_tls_proxy: run the MITM HTTP CONNECT TLS proxy on a specified port with CA cert and key
run_tls_proxy_with_host_key: run the TLS proxy with a pre-generated host key for certificate signing
run_tls_proxy_with_upstream_proxy: run the TLS proxy routing upstream connections through an HTTP CONNECT proxy
review_tls_proxy_health_check: review the TLS proxy health check endpoint that responds to GET /healthz requests
review_tls_proxy_cert_generation: review the per-host certificate generation using OpenSSL with faketime for signing
